meta.name: Magehold Fairwinds
meta.short_description: Crew a leaking airship across five acts of painted sky. Route Flow, raise wind shields, cast from the Casting Room and board your enemies in real-time-with-pause battles, then pay off the debt, if you can. An airship roguelite set in the world of Magehold.

meta.name: Little Angler
meta.short_description: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

meta.name: 7 Millimeters
meta.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

meta.name: SND
meta.short_description: You are hiding in a locker. Don't panic... It passes in front of you. You stay hidden. Its footsteps fade. Should you get out now, or will it come back? You're trapped in a facility plunged into pitch-black darkness. You can hear it. You can hide from it but you can't kill it...

meta.name: Kitchen Traitor
meta.short_description: Cook together. Question everyone. Kitchen Traitor is a first-person cooking and social deduction game for 4–8 players online. Chop, cook and serve across three restaurants while hidden traitors turn mistakes into sabotage. Call a meeting, choose who to trust and keep the restaurant open.

meta.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
meta.short_description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

meta.name: KEEP IT ON HER
meta.short_description: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

meta.name: Something in the Rows
meta.short_description: First-person survival horror in a corn maze at night. Find the eight wards hidden across Halloway Farms and carry them to the chained gate. Every ward you take lets the Harvester closer. The maze is different every run. Play alone or with up to three friends online.

meta.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
meta.short_description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

meta.name: Coffee Keeper
meta.short_description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

meta.name: Railwright
meta.short_description: Design and build your own rail vehicles, lay the tracks they run on, drive your creations, haul cargo, and develop new technology in an open-ended railway engineering sandbox.

meta.name: Pancake! No break!
meta.short_description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

meta.name: DODGE GAME
meta.short_description: Dodge relentless enemy swarms, build score-multiplying combos, and unleash devastating powers in a fast-paced arcade survival game. Conquer evolving arenas, defeat intense bosses, and climb the leaderboards.

meta.name: SHAME
meta.short_description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

meta.name: ABAX
meta.short_description: A Classic Board Game Experience , Original Game design and mechanics should be engaging and challenging even for the most experienced board game enthusiast. Utilizing a Dice Roll Mechanic for all actions so even the most well planned strategy may fall apart.

meta.name: Gen'ei ninja
meta.short_description: Punch, leap and wall-jump through a retro side-scrolling action platformer. Battle through twelve areas and five bosses, collect weapons, and learn when to evade or strike. Gen'ei ninja combines platforming with close-range combat and old-school challenge.

meta.name: SpellWeave
meta.short_description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

meta.name: Paper and Pencil
meta.short_description: A cosy newspaper of puzzles. Eighteen columns — sudoku, crosswords, nonograms, mazes and more — printed fresh every day, solved over a pixel-art coffee. Ten columns free forever; the Sunday Edition adds eight deeper puzzles. Fully offline, endless extras, and every puzzle has exactly one solution.

meta.name: The Consumed
meta.short_description: Play as a Night-Shift Mall Security Guard in this first-person analog horror game. Check, secure, and attempt to survive the haunted shops in this dying mall.

meta.name: Tensei Brave
meta.short_description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

meta.name: Catch The Ducks
meta.short_description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

meta.name: Lily or Horse
meta.short_description: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

meta.name: Fire Bug
meta.short_description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

meta.name: Gross Survivors
meta.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

meta.name: Village of the Mirror
meta.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

meta.name: Give Us Back Gravity
meta.short_description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

meta.name: +PROTECTUS-
meta.short_description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

meta.name: Elya
meta.short_description: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

meta.name: Hazard Crew
meta.short_description: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

meta.name: River Secret
meta.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

meta.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
meta.short_description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

meta.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
meta.short_description: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

meta.name: The Third Seal
meta.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

meta.name: Gimby
meta.short_description: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

meta.name: Excids: Endless Siege
meta.short_description: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

5373170.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless

meta.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless
meta.short_description: Walk through Claude Monet's paintings as a Great War veteran carrying his wife's ashes to the sea. Stop, look closer, and paint color back into the world he lost. A quiet, wordless pilgrimage where stillness is rewarded.

meta.name: 单机斗地主
meta.short_description: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

meta.name: Untitled Maze Game
meta.short_description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird guy.cs this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

meta.name: Outcast Tales
meta.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

5005180.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move

meta.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
meta.short_description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

meta.name: Taskbar Parade
meta.short_description: A desktop companion game: a tiny parade of cute animals walks along the top of your taskbar while you work. Pet them, catch sparkles on the road, grant their daily wishes, send them exploring, and collect hats, friends and souvenirs. Quiet by default — it never gets in the way.

meta.name: Adultery Marriage Punisher
meta.short_description: "Adultery Marriage Punisher" Curing marriage pests! Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit. What is your spouse doing behind your back? Your evidence, the deadliest sanction. Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

meta.name: Grim Guild
meta.short_description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

meta.name: TRAPPIST-1
meta.short_description: A short sci-fi horror game. Extract energy from a red dwarf, tune signals, and power distant worlds. Do your job. Don't ask what really keeps the station running.

meta.name: Picpic
meta.short_description: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

meta.name: Foodland Puzzle
meta.short_description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

meta.name: DOOM MATES
meta.short_description: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

meta.name: Mahjong Rush
meta.short_description: MAHJONG RUSH is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

meta.name: Only Luck
meta.short_description: Five sixes is a 1 in 7776 roll. How about 1 in 10? Only Luck is a pixel-art dice clicker: click to charge your throw, toss up to 9 dice, collect 1100 rare combinations and earn prestige chips. Upgrade your table, spin the Wheel of Luck and bend the rules until the impossible roll becomes routine.

meta.name: History Experience: Rome
meta.short_description: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

meta.name: Operator: Observation
meta.short_description: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

meta.name: Spook & Sell
meta.short_description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

meta.name: Tetheg
meta.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

meta.name: Adventurer 95
meta.short_description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

meta.name: Change
meta.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

meta.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
meta.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

meta.name: Tilt Rivals
meta.short_description: Fast-paced pinball meets head-to-head competition. Challenge rivals online, face a friend in local PvP or take on the CPU solo. Defend your goal, unleash power-ups and survive double-ball chaos across unlockable arenas. One more point. One more rematch.

meta.name: Demonfall Continent
developers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
meta.short_description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

meta.name: Chain of Command
meta.short_description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

meta.name: Flipping Phantom
meta.short_description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

meta.name: Memory Access Violation
meta.short_description: A first-person dream in rectangular prisms. Wander 27 corrupted memories of light and geometry: bend light through prisms, recall platforms that aren't there, ride a light cycle, and face the Warden, a giant soldier the war forgot.

meta.name: Project Nekrios
meta.short_description: A co-op sci-fi horror shooter for 1–4 players. Hold a derelict space station against endless waves of aliens: weld the barricades shut, haul in salvage with tractor beams, restore power, and build new rooms, weapons and upgrades to survive one more round.

meta.name: One More Brick
meta.short_description: A cozy incremental brick breaker on a scribbled sketchbook page. Smash bricks, collect the rewards, and buy upgrades until balls split, lasers fly, and the page gets wonderfully messy. Grow your skill tree, put the Infinite Breaker to work, and turn over a new page.

meta.name: Nitro Nonsense
meta.short_description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

meta.name: Zanoka
meta.short_description: ZANOKA is a single-player roguelike action hack and slash and survivorlike where every sword swing is yours. Chain light and heavy cuts into combos, time your dodges and combine elemental upgrades against enemy waves and bosses. Every run is different, and every run can reveal a new build.

meta.name: Jewel Reels
meta.short_description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

meta.name: Beast Hunt
meta.short_description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

meta.name: Leikkaus
meta.short_description: One student, one abandoned university, and someone who is after their benefits... or more. Hide. Run. Don't get cut.

meta.name: wishbound
meta.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

meta.name: Climb for Kittens
meta.short_description: Build your way up a giant tree to rescue stranded kittens! Craft and connect different objects, create your own climbing paths, and overcome tricky heights. Every rescued kitten unlocks new building materials. Build higher, don't fall, and save them all!

meta.name: Halloween 3D
meta.short_description: A haunted manor, its creatures and nine letters to gather. Explore the levels alone, fight up to four friends online, or build the shared manor with every player: a world made of blocks that everyone reshapes, and that stays.

meta.name: Cardtographer
meta.short_description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

meta.name: Hot Mic
meta.short_description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

meta.name: Galactic Bounty
meta.short_description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

meta.name: The Drowned Table
meta.short_description: A horror dice roguelike. After a shipwreck you wake at a table that keeps score. Cast strange dice, set your Curios to fire left to right, and meet each offering while presences enter the cabin and the sea rises. Eight depths to The Abyss, then Endless.

meta.name: Barony
meta.short_description: Barony is the premier first-person roguelike with cooperative play! Adventure alone, or gather a party with iconic and unusual RPG classes to face off against the brutal dungeons. Test your resourcefulness, wits, and friendships, on your quest to lift the evil lich's curse!

meta.name: Kerbal Space Program
meta.short_description: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

meta.name: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
meta.short_description: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an intense, action-movie inspired single player shooter created for VR and Non-VR. As a professional hitman, take on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld - one contract at a time.

meta.name: Jump Space
meta.short_description: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

meta.name: Tears of Metal
meta.short_description: Fight solo or up to 4-player co-op to reclaim your island alongside your Scottish battalion. On each campaign, gain new powerful upgrades, rally your forces, and stop the invader as they carve into the Mother Stone to harvest its power.

meta.name: Subnautica
meta.short_description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

meta.name: XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION
meta.short_description: LIGHTNING STRIKES AGAIN!! XENOTILT, the sequel to the cult hit, DEMON'S TILT. Get ready for another PINBALL FANTASY. XENOTILT shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.

meta.name: I Am Your Beast
meta.short_description: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

meta.name: The Escapists 2
meta.short_description: Craft, Steal, Brawl and Escape! It’s time to bust out of the toughest prisons in the world as you return to the life of an inmate in The Escapists 2, now with multiplayer! Have you got what it takes to escape?

meta.name: Five Nights with Maids
meta.short_description: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

meta.name: Legion Breaker
meta.short_description: Legion Breaker is an active incremental game about growing a novice wizard into an unstoppable battlemage. Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes across expanding battlefields on your way to the Necromancer King.

meta.name: Beyond These Stars
meta.short_description: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

meta.name: Gunfire Reborn
meta.short_description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse Build gameplay, use various weapons to explore procedurally-generated levels. You can play the game alone, or join 4-player coop.

meta.name: Airport Security Sucks!
meta.short_description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

meta.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
meta.short_description: The title of “fastest” never fades. Race through the sealed future Tokyo night highways in your customized car. Defeat rivals in “SP Battle,” where drivers clash by draining Spirit Points. A unique racing game where only the rules for victory matter.

meta.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
meta.short_description: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

meta.name: Tiny Glade
meta.short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

meta.name: Blasphemous
meta.short_description: Blasphemous is a brutal action-platformer with skilled hack’n slash combat set in the nightmare world of Cvstodia. Explore, upgrade your abilities, and perform savage executions on the hordes of enemies that stand between you and your quest to break eternal damnation.

293760.name: Automation - The Car Company Tycoon Game

meta.name: Automation - The Car Company Tycoon Game
meta.short_description: Make your dream cars a reality with Automation’s unparalleled car and engine design tools. Gain a competitive edge through smart engineering and business decisions to help you build an automotive empire. Will you become an industry leader, or just a footnote in automotive history?

meta.name: Liftoff®: FPV Drone Racing
meta.short_description: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

meta.name: The House in Fata Morgana
meta.short_description: A gothic suspense tale set in a cursed mansion. "The House in Fata Morgana" is a full-length visual novel spanning nearly a millennium that deals in tragedy, human nature, and insanity.

meta.name: Forever Ago
meta.short_description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

meta.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
meta.short_description: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Simulation, Sports, Strategy

meta.name: CloverPit
meta.short_description: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

meta.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
meta.short_description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

meta.name: Crime Simulator
meta.short_description: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

meta.name: Lost Castle 2
meta.short_description: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

meta.name: Stacklands
meta.short_description: Stacklands is a village builder where you stack cards to collect food, build structures, and fight creatures. 🃏 For example, dragging a Villager card on top of a Berry Bush card will spawn Berry cards which the villagers can eat to survive. 🃏 Play your cards right and expand your village!

spy.publisher: Kyle Thompson, Top Hat Studios, Inc., Doyoyo Games

meta.name: Well Dweller
meta.short_description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

meta.name: Dicevaders
meta.short_description: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

meta.name: Unity of Command II
meta.short_description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

3614130.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop

meta.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
meta.short_description: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?

meta.name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
meta.short_description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

meta.name: Library Of Ruina
meta.short_description: "May you find your book in this place." Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage. Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward. And eventually, get your hands on… The one singular, perfect book.

meta.name: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
meta.short_description: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

meta.name: Enter the Gungeon
meta.short_description: Enter the Gungeon is a bullet hell dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

spy.genre: Action, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Simulation, Strategy

meta.name: Gallipoli
meta.short_description: Land on the beaches of Gallipoli and fight intense 50-player objective-based battles on the Ottoman Fronts! Experience WW1 trench warfare and desert expeditions as one of 10 historic classes, armed with authentic weaponry. Gallipoli brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet.

meta.name: Deckbound
meta.short_description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

meta.name: Robot Fisher
meta.short_description: Third person fishing simulation game, where player controls lonely robot who are just fishing

meta.name: Uncanny Train
meta.short_description: A horror puzzle walking simulator. Trapped aboard a strange train, your goal is to reach Carriage -1. Along the way, you will encounter eerie anomalies and solve environmental puzzles. Headphones are recommended for full immersion.

meta.name: PLEASE WAIT
meta.short_description: A comedy game about installing a game. Get the progress bar from 0% to 100% while the installer stalls, bargains, lies, makes you agree to agree, runs away from your cursor and refuses to finish. One window. One loading bar. Please wait.

meta.name: ARCS
meta.short_description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

meta.name: MECCHA LIAR
meta.short_description: 2 to 4 participants gathered in pursuit of a massive cash prize. The moment they open their eyes, they are trapped in unfamiliar darkness and each other's lies. In a place where no one can be trusted, only one can survive.

5297320.name: JIGOKU YUGI: Only The Last Gambler Standing Returns to Life

meta.name: JIGOKU YUGI: Only The Last Gambler Standing Returns to Life
meta.short_description: You died slipping on your own winning lottery ticket. Now you're one of 100 corpses in Hell's Ninth Gambling Den: 32 sadistic games, each with a hidden trap, a cheating demon croupier and your funeral streaming live. Only the last gambler standing returns to life.

meta.name: Sudoku Unlimited
meta.short_description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

meta.name: Subject Zero
meta.short_description: You are a scientist turned into test subject zero, forced to fight the infection by venturing through your own nightmares. Will you survive.

meta.name: Messa Anomaly
meta.short_description: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

meta.name: Inky's Sleep
meta.short_description: Step into Inky’s sleep — a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

meta.name: BioSphere: Genesis
meta.short_description: A science clicker inspired by real biochemistry. Grow a living planet from elementary particles: catch atoms, fuse them into molecules, synthesize amino acids, proteins and cells — turn raw matter into life through simple clicks. No prestige points, only natural units.

meta.name: Elevator Button Simulator
meta.short_description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

meta.name: Red Rain
meta.short_description: Survive a decimated yet beautiful post-apocalyptic landscape as Allie, a competent survivalist and mother raising her daughter against the backdrop of a broken world.

meta.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
meta.short_description: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

meta.name: Cutout Village
meta.short_description: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

meta.name: Grease Trap '99
meta.short_description: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

meta.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
meta.short_description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

meta.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
meta.short_description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king’s ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

meta.name: Fish Wrangler
meta.short_description: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

meta.name: SAKIMORI
meta.short_description: Explore cursed locations, locate cursed objects, and purify them. Alongside the guardian Saku Tsukino, confront the curse within an anomalous space, purify the cursed objects, and survive. A first-person horror Roguelite set in abandoned Japanese locations.

meta.name: Halloween On Goober Street
meta.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

meta.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
meta.short_description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

meta.name: The Wrong Way
meta.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

meta.name: Lighthouse of Madness
meta.short_description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

meta.name: Ashnar's Lair
meta.short_description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

meta.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
meta.short_description: Battles run on their own. Send a party of four into dungeons, scoop up piles of gear, upgrade it, and push deeper. With levels up to 999 and over 100 dungeons, this is an idle hack-and-slash RPG that keeps going while you watch.

meta.name: Wartide
meta.short_description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

meta.name: Run, Run from the Blast!
meta.short_description: Challenge yourself in a frantic escape through an urban environment, where every mistake brings you one step closer to your demise. Only a perfect run will truly give you a chance to make it out alive.

meta.name: Abandoned Hearts
meta.short_description: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

meta.name: Hurl
meta.short_description: HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena. The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

meta.name: Spin To Win
meta.short_description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

meta.name: Dub House
meta.short_description: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

meta.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
meta.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.

5292500.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式

meta.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
meta.short_description: A graduation that breaks, again and again. It should have been an ordinary day where all you had to do was choose which friend to talk to first. The order changes the conversations, and each loop warps the scene. Your friends' smiles fade. A visual novel about friendship. Broken, with care.

5104990.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables

meta.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
meta.short_description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

meta.name: Chained Pirates Together
meta.short_description: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

meta.name: Fungal Field
meta.short_description: Start with a seed. Change more than the landscape. Fungal Field is an ecological sandbox where colonies grow, wildlife forages, and fungal infection can turn deer and humans into zombies. Nurture the soil. Shape the conditions. Discover what grows from here.

meta.name: Lost Jelly
meta.short_description: An arcade adventure with a new twist!🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

meta.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
meta.short_description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

meta.name: Empty The Lake!
meta.short_description: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

meta.name: Sakura Hime 7
meta.short_description: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

meta.name: RETURN TO 1990
meta.short_description: Reborn in 1990 Seoul with memories of 2027. Rewrite twenty years through stocks, real estate and startups in this business-sim visual novel.

meta.name: Atrion Project
meta.short_description: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

meta.name: Trivia Mania
meta.short_description: Welcome to Trivia Mania! Test your knowledge about the most common trivia questions, and improve your own performance. Trivia Mania has over 4,700 questions across eight genres. Game modes such as the Gauntlet, Ladder, Survival and Custom allow you to play in different fun and interactive ways.

meta.name: Little Spring
meta.short_description: Compress. Aim. Release. Guide a little spring through the pages of an old patent. Judge slopes, ride moving platforms and set curious mechanisms in motion across 20 handcrafted physics challenges. Unlock six springs, each with a character of its own.

meta.name: Tow Game
meta.short_description: Tow Game is a physics-based action game where you control a car being towed by a tow truck. Swing around the environment using the tow cable and earn points by causing chaos and destruction.

meta.name: Tidy Tails
meta.short_description: Your cat has turned the shop upside down, and 5,555 cat plushies are waiting to go back on their shelves. Upgrade your skills and your cat's, change the weather to transform the gameplay, play minigames and hunt for collectibles while you wonder what the garage hides once everything is tidy.

meta.name: Battle Nap
meta.short_description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

meta.name: Flamebound Tactics
meta.short_description: Flamebound Tactics is a pixel-art strategy puzzle. Place units on suitable terrain, combine their unique coverage patterns, and light every brazier without exceeding the budget. Solve 30 handcrafted stages across islands of varied shapes and terrain.

meta.name: Orbital Madness
meta.short_description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

meta.name: UNCOUNTED
meta.short_description: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

3911820.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color

meta.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
meta.short_description: 🐱 Discover 200 hidden cats across 2 artistic hand-drawn scenes 🖌️. Relax with color-by-numbers 🎨 and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op 👯‍♂️, while Meow FM 🎶 sets the perfect creative mood.

meta.name: Terra Machina
meta.short_description: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

meta.name: Mojo Is Loved
meta.short_description: Mojo invites his ex and an old friend to hear his new EP. Their kindness is real... until the room starts rewriting every sign of rejection. A short psychological horror visual novel about love, reassurance, and the cost of demanding certainty.

meta.name: Pactmage - Chess Roster
meta.short_description: Pactmage: Chess Roster is a turn-based tactics game where every character has skills and an element. Win in Adventure Mode and form a Pact to recruit them — all 60+ units are free. Play the story mode, fight a friend locally, or battle online in PvP. No gacha, no paid units.

meta.name: Rouge and Run
meta.short_description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

meta.name: Evercursed: Act I
meta.short_description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

meta.name: Who Invited You?
meta.short_description: Some of your party guests were never invited. They look like your friends, answer to their names, and behave exactly the same. Photos, messages and phone calls are the only proof. Find them before the night ends — alone or with up to three friends.

meta.name: The Guest from the Fields
meta.short_description: Something is standing in the wheat. Each time you see it, it's closer — and it isn't human. Your grandmother says you shouldn't have looked at it.

meta.name: The Grave Abyss
meta.short_description: Grab your sword and descend to the deepest depths of a corrupted cave to find and destroy the source of evil that plagues the small town of Oakhaven. The Grave Abyss is an old school single player, 3d dungeon crawler RPG with turn based combat.

meta.name: Eric's Farm
meta.short_description: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

meta.name: Rêverie: Audio Stories
meta.short_description: Close your eyes, listen, and choose. Rêverie brings you illustrated audio stories where your choices change the ending. Two free stories: a king's messenger on a stormy medieval night, and a fairy tale full of songs for young and old. No ads.

meta.name: DEAD TIME
meta.short_description: Nobody can see the timers. 2–8 players strapped to their chairs at a sinister game-show table, shock collars on: estimate time blind, bluff, call people out. Miss the time and the collar answers; get doubted and the doubter pulls the trigger. Local, online or solo vs. bots.

meta.name: Zombie Last Stand
meta.short_description: Take your last stand against an evolving zombie swarm. Fight ten enemy types and two deadly bosses, collect special bullets, armor and permanent upgrades, survive extreme weather events, unlock SWAT skins, complete achievements, and chase a higher score with every run.

meta.name: The 31st Student
meta.short_description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, uncover conflicting records, and confront the memories you helped erase. A first-person psychological horror mystery with three endings. Play on a monitor or in VR.

meta.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
meta.short_description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

meta.name: Last Light: Chalk Creek
meta.short_description: Three strangers are stranded in a rural town overrun by the infected and things that crawl out of the ground. Fight through an illustrated three-chapter story or hold out for three days in an isometric shooter with nine weapons, destructible scenery, dynamic weather and a day–night cycle.

meta.name: PALJA Survivors
meta.short_description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

meta.name: ALYSSA
meta.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

meta.name: Lumbrix
meta.short_description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

meta.name: Mimic Alert
meta.short_description: You are on a service to detect and destroy mimics — creatures capable of taking the form of any object. Carefully inspect your surroundings and use all your attentiveness to detect them. Play the full campaign in online two-player co-op with a friend.

meta.name: THERMAL RUNAWAY
meta.short_description: A top-down roguelite inside one sealed chamber. Ten levels, one hundred waves, and upgrades that compound into something the facility was not built to contain. The run ends when you break — or when the reaction does.

meta.name: Second Source
meta.short_description: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

meta.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
meta.short_description: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

meta.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
meta.short_description: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

meta.name: Fruitpocalypse
meta.short_description: The veggies have risen. Only the fruits stand in their way. Survive 20 waves of evil vegetables, twisted bosses and cursed nights in this cartoon arena roguelite.

meta.name: Retro Pond
meta.short_description: Breed unique fish, discover rare mutations and grow your pond.

meta.name: Dealer's Choice
meta.short_description: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

meta.name: Blue Prince
meta.short_description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

meta.name: Project Hospital
meta.short_description: Become an ace doctor, an aspiring architect and a successful manager at the same time. Design your very own hospital, tweak every detail or choose one of the prebuilt scenarios and just jump to the doctor’s duty.

meta.name: Evitania Online - Idle RPG
meta.short_description: Online Idle RPG with an open world without the grind of classic MMORPGs. Collect rare loot, develop your character, master professions, craft powerful gear, and defeat challenging bosses as you progress endlessly.

meta.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
meta.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

meta.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
meta.short_description: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this ♡♡♡♡ world with your degen otaku-posting.

meta.name: Goose Goose Duck
meta.short_description: Goose Goose Duck is a game of social deduction for up to 16 players. Players are separated into different groups that are each assigned a different objective. Complete your team’s objective to win!

meta.name: Tribes of Midgard
meta.short_description: A vibrant blend of survival and action RPG for 1-10 players! Craft legendary items, grow your home base and embark on an epic journey through procedural realms to face towering creatures hel-bent on unleashing Ragnarök. Valhalla can wait, Einherjar!

meta.name: Eslabong
meta.short_description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

spy.genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, RPG, Simulation, Sports

meta.name: DRAPLINE
meta.short_description: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

meta.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
meta.short_description: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!

meta.name: Across the Obelisk
meta.short_description: Set forth in a co-op roguelite deckbuilder where every choice matters! Craft decks of breathtaking power. Journey alone or with up to three friends. Plot your party’s path to glory and face powerful enemies in deep tactical combat on your quest to save the kingdom of Senenthia in Across the Obelisk!

meta.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
meta.short_description: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

meta.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
meta.short_description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

meta.name: Undervein
meta.short_description: Deep under the mountain there is a seam that never runs dry, a crew of dwarves who will mine it while you sleep, and a door covered in runes that nobody has opened. Click. Build. Descend. And be ready when the mountain's wrath wakes.
